alpha_policy.alpha_0_25_reason: Only 15 entries total and 3/6/6 across H1_OOF/H2/H3; failed frozen opportunity coverage gate.
alpha_policy.alpha_1_reason: Reference-only exact reproduction of Strategy-v1 zero-cent policy; prior Strategy-v1 economics already exposed and family failed.
alpha_policy.entry_selection: Consume exact frozen 21N-F alpha_event_selections.csv; never reselect after outcomes are opened.

conditions: base pooled mean P&L per event > 0
+1c stressed pooled mean P&L per event > 0
base mean P&L per event > 0 in at least 4 of 5 chronological 514-event blocks
base mean P&L per event > 0 in newest chronological block B4
base H3 mean P&L per event > 0
development_gate.winner_rule: Among alphas passing every condition, choose highest +1c stressed pooled mean P&L per event; exact numeric tie chooses lower alpha.

development_scope.block_order_rule: sort unique events by event_close_time_utc ascending, then event_ticker ascending

failure_consequence.if_no_development_alpha_passes: Reject simple reliability-shrinkage Strategy-v2 development family and return to predeclared successor research, with a distinct learned entry/meta-model now a justified candidate.

future_c1_c2_confirmation.authorization_condition: Only after one development alpha passes, is selected by the frozen rule, and the development result is separately frozen/closed.
conditions: base pooled mean P&L per event > 0
+1c stressed pooled mean P&L per event > 0
base mean P&L per event > 0 in at least 4 of 5 chronological 200-event blocks
base mean P&L per event > 0 in newest chronological block
future_c1_c2_confirmation.evidence_interpretation: fresh strategy-economic confirmation only; C1/C2 outcomes were previously exposed for other model research
future_c1_c2_confirmation.failure_consequence: Reject reliability-shrinkage Strategy-v2 family; do not repair/retune on C1+C2.

realized_economics.interpretation: quoted-entry screening only; not a historical fill simulation and not Gate-1 paper-strategy eligibility
realized_economics.position_policy: hold selected side to settlement; no early exit, re-entry, adding, averaging, side switching, stops, targets, or sizing optimization

stress_policy.interpretation: sensitivity analysis only; not an empirical slippage, depth, queue, latency, partial-fill, or missed-fill estimate
stress_policy.invalid_price_rule: If any selected trade has stressed price outside [0,1], mark that alpha/stress scenario invalid as a whole; do not cap, omit, interpolate, or impute.
